title: TODSphere: open-data screening of transit-oriented development with the Node–Place–People–Ecology (NPPE) framework
description:
TODSphere is a browser-based, zero-installation tool that computes seven open-data indicators of transit-oriented development readiness from OpenStreetMap and CAMS, aggregates them into the Node, Place, People and Ecology (NPPE) dimensions and reports the composites A1 (weighted arithmetic), A2 (dimension mean) and A3 (geometric), the balance ratio and the limiting dimension, with corridor ranking and robustness analysis.

Version 2.1.0 implements methodology NPPE-7 v1.0.0 and includes the analysis data and scripts needed to reproduce the accompanying manuscript (npm run reproduce).
